content: Low friction logging QoL features are universal table stakes: saved meals and meal combos, copy previous meal or day, favorites, recent or smart history predicting usual foods, quick add calories only, photo and voice logging. MacroFactor efficiency features include favorites, smart history, copy paste of foods meals and days, quick add, AI logging with editable breakdown. Nutrola markets saved combos plus pattern learning reducing daily logging to about 15 seconds. Flex Diet covers presets; copy yesterday and quick add are cheap high value additions.
